Concreteness = observable decision/action/sequence/tradeoff/consequence, carried by the generic-scenario and sourced-facts license lines ('Concrete is fine; a scene is not required'; 'never force a cast, prop, setting, or scene'). No biographical/sensory/temporal/quantitative demand anywhere on the card.

CAST block: invented people default to ROLE LABELS; a reserved name spends only inside a clearly-framed constructed application (the dealt lead thread qualifies) where it materially helps. The DEAL is unchanged (book-disjoint reservation, protected-name union, proxy-cast ban + cast-emptying intact); only the rendered register changed, so dealt state, lineage keys, and regen budgets are byte-identical.

Sourced-identity-in-invented-event is prevented structurally at the deal (protected-name union: an invented cast name can never be a real source person) and prohibited on the constructed-license card line ('Never merge a real person or organization into an invented event'); C37.unsupported_scene_completion catches unlicensed scene staging. Entity-level cross-referencing of prose names against packet identities is IMP-09's named-entity work.

First-entry register: framingRequired renders on constructed/analogy licenses; the invented lead thread is now TYPED as a constructed application with first-entry non-factual clarity in varied natural wording ('no single fixed phrase') plus the never-report-as-history rule; varied-framing tests prove no magic phrase. REJECTION of deceptive conditional-then-history prose is semantic and deferred to the blinded review + calibration.

sourceRegisterRepairFindings emits frozen RepairFindingV1: unit ids from the plan, implicated plan field in sourcePlanDependencies, offending span in evidenceQuotes, severity, bounded permittedRepairScope per check, prohibitedChanges pinning all five plan fields. Scope mapping is a code constant — tested under INJECTION_STRINGS in prose and plan ids; free-form text cannot broaden edits.

Generic and constructed applications pass CLEAN with zero proper nouns under the most restrictive plan (tested); integration note recorded for IMP-09 that named-entity presence must not be a grounding proxy.

The IMP-05 dieted self-verify already carries the compact plan-mismatch/unsupported-detail check (FACTS: every name, number, quote, event must appear in the packet — cut it otherwise) and cannot self-waive anything: C37 and all critics run conductor-side on the candidate. No new unenveloped data path: source projection, prior findings, and repair criteria ride the IMP-03 typed untrusted envelope with the control instruction; the plan card block is conductor-rendered instruction text from the hash-bound compiler artifact (a tampered plan fails validation/staleness, and hostile strings in plan fields were tested inert).

Upstream routing: the decision policy's stop arm, C37 message text ('Route a genuine causal claim upstream to source-plan recompile'), recommendedRoute=surgical for prose softening, and prohibitedChanges preventing any local metadata relabel.

Bounded-patch preservation: permittedRepairScope confines each C37 repair to the implicated fields (claim -> breakdown/quiz/keyTakeaway/memorableLines; scene -> examples; leak -> examples/breakdown), the RepairFindingV1 interface IMP-07's patch lane consumes.

IMP-11 owns the FP-rate calibration and any promotion to blocker; promoting without that data would violate the conflict matrix.

Deceptive conditional framing (opens hypothetical, later asserts the event as history) has NO deterministic detector — a lexical one would be FP-heavy or a de-facto magic-phrase test, both forbidden. Mitigated by the framing card rules + the C37 symptom checks; owned semantically by IMP-08's blinded review.
